entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Raja Inal Siregar was governor of North Sumatra from 1988 to 1998. He was among the Mandala Airlines Flight 091 crash victims, succumbing to his injuries a day after the crash. He was said to be on his way to talks with then-Indonesian President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono at the time.
